_about: Spell effect presets for the battle map (page and .claude/scripts/battlemap.py). Shapes, sizes, durations and trigger notes come from the SRD files in .claude/dnd-5e-srd (checked with srd_lookup.py). rounds: 1 minute = 10 rounds, 10 minutes = 100, 1 hour = 600; instant effects stay for 1 round so the table can see who was hit. size is feet: radius for sphere, side for cube, length for cone and line. A sphere with a cylinder height is drawn as a circle. kind picks the colour on the board: damage, obscure, dark, terrain, utility. source SRD = checked against the SRD; anything else must be verified by the DM.

presets.name: Cloud of Daggers
presets.source: PHB, not in the SRD: verify
presets.note: Verify against the PHB (not in the SRD). As commonly run: a creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 4d4 slashing damage; no save.

presets.name: Moonbeam
presets.note: 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder; dim light inside. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save: 2d10 radiant on a failure, half on a success (a shapechanger saves with disadvantage and reverts on a failure).

presets.name: Spirit Guardians
presets.note: 15-foot radius around the caster (moves with them). Affected creatures' speed is halved in the area. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Wisdom save: 3d8 radiant (caster good or neutral) or necrotic (caster evil) on a failure, half on a success. The caster can exempt creatures.

presets.name: Fog Cloud
presets.note: 20-foot-radius sphere of fog that spreads around corners; heavily obscured. Lasts until a moderate or stronger wind disperses it.

presets.name: Stinking Cloud
presets.note: 20-foot-radius sphere of gas, heavily obscured. A creature completely within it at the start of its turn makes a Constitution save against poison or spends its action retching and reeling. Creatures that don't breathe or are immune to poison succeed.

presets.name: Cloudkill
presets.note: 20-foot-radius poisonous fog, heavily obscured. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save: 5d8 poison on a failure, half on a success. The fog moves 10 feet away from the caster at the start of each of the caster's turns.

presets.name: Darkness
presets.note: 15-foot-radius magical darkness that spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision can't see through it; nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

presets.name: Web
presets.note: 20-foot cube of webs: difficult terrain, lightly obscured. A creature that starts its turn in the webs or enters them during its turn makes a Dexterity save or is restrained until it breaks free (Strength check against the spell save DC as an action).

presets.name: Entangle
presets.note: 20-foot square of weeds and vines: difficult terrain. A creature in the area when cast makes a Strength save or is restrained until the spell ends (Strength check against the spell save DC as an action).

presets.name: Spike Growth
presets.note: 20-foot radius of spikes: difficult terrain. A creature that moves into or within the area takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels. Camouflaged as natural ground.

presets.name: Grease
presets.note: 10-foot square: difficult terrain. Each creature standing in it when it appears, and each that enters or ends its turn there, makes a Dexterity save or falls prone.

presets.name: Silence
presets.note: 20-foot-radius sphere: no sound can be created within or pass through it; creatures and objects entirely inside are immune to thunder damage and are deafened; verbal spells cannot be cast inside.

presets.name: Faerie Fire
presets.note: 20-foot cube. Objects are outlined; a creature in the area when cast is outlined if it fails a Dexterity save. Attack rolls against an outlined creature have advantage if the attacker can see it, and it can't benefit from being invisible.

presets.name: Hypnotic Pattern
presets.note: 30-foot cube. Each creature in the area that sees the pattern makes a Wisdom save (see the SRD for the effect on a failure). The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes.

presets.name: Fireball
presets.note: 20-foot-radius sphere, instantaneous. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save: 8d6 fire on a failure, half on a success (higher slots add 1d6 per level above 3rd). The fire spreads around corners.

presets.name: Burning Hands
presets.note: 15-foot cone from the caster, instantaneous. Dexterity save: 3d6 fire on a failure, half on a success.

presets.name: Thunderwave
presets.note: 15-foot cube originating from the caster, instantaneous. Constitution save: 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 feet away on a failure, half damage and no push on a success.

presets.name: Lightning Bolt
presets.note: 100-foot line, 5 feet wide, from the caster. Dexterity save: 8d6 lightning on a failure, half on a success.

presets.name: Cone of Cold
presets.note: 60-foot cone from the caster, instantaneous. Constitution save: 8d8 cold on a failure, half on a success.
